name: Oren Cass

lean.basis: Domestic policy director of Mitt Romney's 2012 campaign; Manhattan Institute senior fellow; founded American Compass in 2020 with encouragement from Republican senators Marco Rubio, Josh Hawley and JD Vance, to push the GOP toward pro-worker economics, tariffs and industrial policy.

sources.title: Conservative Economic Populists Are Taking a Victory Lap — Yahoo News

current_role: Founder and chief economist, American Compass
summary: Oren Cass was domestic policy director for Mitt Romney's 2012 presidential campaign and a Manhattan Institute senior fellow (2015–2019). His book The Once and Future Worker (2018) argued for putting workers before consumers; in 2020 he founded the think tank American Compass, whose main political allies are JD Vance, Marco Rubio and Josh Hawley. Vance and Rubio both spoke at its fifth-anniversary gala in June 2025.
